approval_required_for: Any proposed architecture or pipeline change
Any change to numeric policy or tolerance values

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep SACG extraction blocked for each failed or unassessed constraint; record checker evidence and not_run status accurately, route the bounded correction to its responsible input owner, and rerun affected registered checkers. Do not guess missing facts, waive checkers, alter golden outputs or numeric policy, or claim hardware pass.
executable_actions.rationale: Consolidate only checker-supported specialist findings and verify cross-layer bindings before SACG extraction. The visible compact summary is insufficient to establish readiness; registered checkers can validate the detailed source inputs and review artifacts without claiming implementation or deployment results.

observations: The candidate summary identifies prepared_inputs.mode as independent_from_scratch_design and reports an empty prepared_inputs.errors list. The compact output does not expose the substantive model, numeric/template, board/runtime, tool/evidence, or human-boundary findings.
The supplied state summary contains no checker results. Empty preparation errors are not checker acceptance, and the SACG graph currently has zero nodes and edges.

No cross-layer contradiction can be confirmed from the visible details. Model dimensions, template bindings, numeric settings, data order and transfer units, memory/runtime assumptions, exact board-wrapper identity, and human approval boundaries remain unassessed at detail level.

Transformer blocks are the complete DUT scope. Embedding/tokenization, final model norm, LM head/logits, sampling, and other model-tail work must remain outside DUT and golden/weight-coverage requirements.

Verification acceptance is current-source VCS compilation, elaboration, and linking only. No VCS result is supplied; runtime loading, simulation execution, numerical comparison, and waveform evidence are not prerequisites.

sacg_memory_truth reports zero active contamination barriers and zero open retry/backtrack requests; no historical blocker is promoted to active. hierarchical_learning_context reports no validated lower-layer evidence.
proposed_actions: Run the registered input-stage checkers against the source inputs and specialist review/gap-matrix artifacts, then publish the cross-layer consistency review and SACG extraction readiness with constraint-linked evidence and explicit not_run statuses where applicable.

Route checker failures or unresolved facts to the responsible model, numeric/template, board/runtime, tool/evidence, or human-boundary input owner. Do not resolve them by inference or by changing approved constraints.
If a correction would change architecture, pipeline, memory layout, numeric policy, or a major template choice, obtain approval before updating the relevant input.
risks: SACG extraction could encode unsupported assumptions if specialist findings and checker outcomes are not surfaced and bound to the named constraints.

The compact summary does not establish whether model shapes and parameter bindings agree with the selected templates, or whether numeric policy and data-order/transfer-unit assumptions agree across layers.

Board memory, runtime, deployment, and tool-protocol consistency is unverified. Board integration must cite the current user-supplied sample-project wrapper and real board materials rather than guess an interface or target.
The candidate's empty preparation error list must not be reported as checker pass, implementation readiness, board readiness, or hardware pass.
output.summary: SACG extraction readiness is blocked pending visible specialist findings and successful input-stage checker results. The supplied summary shows prepared_inputs.errors is empty, but contains no detailed cross-layer reviews or checker outcomes; this is not evidence of consistency or hardware verification. No specific contradiction or hardware failure is established.
